info.title: Exto Data API
info.description: Read and write Exto data directly over REST, using a Personal Access Token. See [Data API](/integrations/data-api) for how to generate a token, and [Reference](/integrations/data-api-reference) for the narrative version of everything below.

tags.name: Module Records
tags.description: Reading and writing module records, including sub-table expansion.

tags.name: Sub-tables & Workflow
tags.description: Writing sub-table rows and taking workflow actions.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Granting, reading, and revoking user and project access.

tags.name: Hierarchy Master Records
tags.description: Reading and writing tree-shaped master data — the same engine as master records, with a parent/child structure.

tags.name: Job Status
tags.description: Tracking background jobs — imports, exports, and other long-running operations.

tags.name: Workflow V2
tags.description: Listing workflow instances and their history, and taking workflow actions by record number.

tags.name: User Management V2
tags.description: Mirrors User Management at /api/v2/user/..., plus two changes.

get.summary: Get module records with sub-table data
get.description: Returns module records together with their sub-table data in one call, paginated independently on both axes. See [Module record expand](/integrations/data-api-module-expand) for the full pagination contract.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: The module's identifier, e.g. `SAT_TDSP`.

parameters.name: recordIds
parameters.description: CSV of Mongo IDs — one record, a batch of up to 100, or omit for the whole module list.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Module record list page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Module record list page size.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: CSV sparse fieldset for the module record itself. Prefix a field with `-` to exclude instead of include.

parameters.name: subTableFields
parameters.description: CSV sparse fieldset applied to every sub-table row. Prefix a field with `-` to exclude instead of include.

parameters.name: subTablePageSize
parameters.description: Default page size for any sub-table without its own override.

parameters.name: subTablePaging
parameters.description: JSON, keyed by `tableID`, of `{page, pageSize}` overrides per sub-table.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Mongo-style filter JSON, merged into the record match.

parameters.name: x-tenant-id
parameters.description: Overrides the tenant resolved from your token. Only needed if your token has access to more than one tenant — otherwise the tenant embedded in the access token / API key is used.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: The project's short reference ID, alongside its Mongo `x-ctx-id`.

parameters.name: x-workspace-id
parameters.description: Scopes the request to one workspace, instead of a project.

400.description: Malformed query parameters.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server.

post.description: Uploads one or more documents in a single request. Attaches files at record level, sub-table level, or checklist-item level depending on the `module`/`ID` pair supplied. See [Document upload & download](/integrations/data-api-documents).

module.description: Target module/entity the file(s) attach to. Requires `ID` when set.

ID.description: Record ID being attached to. Required whenever `module` is present.

meta.description: JSON-encoded metadata object applied to every file. Per-file `docTitle` always defaults to that file's own name.

linkedRefID.description: Reference ID linking the upload to a related record.

groupID.description: Document group to file the upload under.

folderID.description: Destination folder in the document manager.

parentID.description: Parent document ID, for versioning under an existing file.

scope.description: JSON-encoded visibility scope array, e.g. ["PROJECT"]. Defaults by context when omitted.

parameters.name: x-tenant-id
parameters.description: Overrides the tenant resolved from your token. Only needed if your token has access to more than one tenant — otherwise the tenant embedded in the access token / API key is used. Required for this endpoint.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: Scopes the request to one project. Required for this endpoint.

parameters.name: x-workspace-id
parameters.description: Scopes the request to one workspace, instead of a project.

200.description: Ok — including a partial upload, where some files failed.

400.description: Missing tenant/project/user in context, no files attached, or `module` given without `ID`.

403.description: Caller isn't a member of the tenant, or lacks access to the project.

parameters.name: x-workspace-id
parameters.description: Scopes the request to one workspace, instead of a project.

200.description: Binary file stream with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="…"`.

400.description: Missing tenant/project in context.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the tenant or project.

404.description: Document doesn't exist, belongs to a different tenant, or its file is missing on disk.

post.description:
Validates and bulk-uploads a commissioning (CX) equipment register against a schedule — the JSON equivalent of importing an equipment register file. See [CX asset registry](/cx/assets).

**⚠️ Deprecated.** Per the API team: the CX Data API endpoints won't support the new 3.0 Cx data structure. Still live and functional against the current (2.0) Cx structure, but don't build new integrations against this — check with the API team for the 3.0 equivalent.

scheduleId.description: The CX schedule the equipment register belongs to.

ParentID.description: Parent equipment ID, for a hierarchy.

Predecessors.description: Comma-separated list of predecessor equipment IDs.

additionalProperties.description: Any other column from your equipment template.

400.description: "Missing tenant ID" / "Missing project ID" / "Missing user name", or the register failed validation.

post.summary: Create checklist records for a CX step
post.description:
Creates module-record checklist entries for a commissioning workflow step, and links them back onto the step's CxEntryLog / subtask. One array element per checklist record; every element needs the same `workfid` (workflow template ID).

**⚠️ Deprecated.** Per the API team: the CX Data API endpoints won't support the new 3.0 Cx data structure. Still live and functional against the current (2.0) Cx structure, but don't build new integrations against this — check with the API team for the 3.0 equivalent.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: The checklist's module, e.g. INSPECTION_CHECKLIST. Upper-cased before lookup.

parameters.name: userName
parameters.description: The acting user — must belong to the current tenant.

workfid.description: Workflow template ID — same value on every element.

activityid.description: Mongo ObjectId of the step's activity.

ex_manualstartdate.description: Optional manual start date; defaults to now, converted to the project timezone.

additionalProperties.description: Any other field on the checklist module's own form.

400.description: Missing user name / project ID, user not found, or a payload is missing a required field.

403.description: User's tenant doesn't include the current tenant.
